mapper.select: SELECT lr.id, lr.username, lr.email, lr.question, lr.status, up.id as userId, up.username as user_name, up.email as userEmail, r.id as roleId, r.role_name, r.description FROM list_request lr LEFT JOIN user_profile up on lr.user_profile_id = up.id LEFT JOIN role r on up.role_id = r.id

SELECT lr.id, lr.username, lr.email, lr.question, lr.status, up.id as userId, up.username as userName, up.email as userEmail, r.id as roleId, r.role_name, r.description FROM list_request lr LEFT JOIN user_profile up on lr.user_profile_id = up.id LEFT JOIN role r on up.role_id = r.id WHERE up.email = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO list_request (username, email, question, user_profile_id, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{question}, (SELECT id FROM user_profile WHERE username = #{username}), #{status})
